title: Children's bedroom, Istanbul apartment
description: A lived-in children's bedroom in an Istanbul apartment, about 3.5 x 4 m. Pale mint-green walls, light laminate parquet, a round blue rug, a white PVC window with sheer tulle curtains and a white panel radiator below it. A single bed with a white wooden frame and a star-pattern duvet stands with its headboard against the left wall. A small white desk with a lamp and colouring pencils sits by the window. A few toys on the floor.

objects.shelf: a long wooden wall shelf mounted on two small metal brackets about 60 cm directly above the head of the bed, loaded with a heavy row of hardcover books, a glass snow globe and a ceramic piggy bank
objects.wardrobe: a tall white two-door wardrobe, 210 cm tall, standing free beside the bed with no visible wall bracket, three cardboard storage boxes and a plastic suitcase stacked on its top almost to the ceiling
objects.picture: a large picture frame with glass, about 70 x 50 cm, showing a painted hot-air balloon, hanging on the wall directly above the headboard
objects.aquarium: a 60-litre glass aquarium with water, gravel and plants, standing on top of a waist-high white chest of drawers
objects.toy_bin: a low blue plastic toy bin on the floor, knee height
objects.door: the open white bedroom door, the doorway clear
